name: Everest Region Trekking
description: Classic trails in the Khumbu region including Everest Base Camp, Gokyo Lakes, and high Sherpa valleys.

name: Annapurna Region Trekking
description: Diverse trekking routes through Gurung villages, massive valleys, and high altitude sanctuary points.

name: Langtang Region Trekking
description: Scenic valleys close to Kathmandu featuring authentic Tamang culture and alpine glaciers.

name: Manaslu Region Trekking
description: Remote restricted trekking loop wrapping around the world's eighth highest mountain, Mt. Manaslu.

name: Mustang Region Trekking
description: Dry arid landscapes and red clay cliffs of the ancient forbidden kingdom of Lo Mustang.

name: Restricted / Remote Area Trekking
description: Wilderness trails requiring special permits, including Kanchenjunga, Makalu, and Dolpo regions.

name: Peak Climbing in Nepal
description: Scale snow summits between 5500m and 6500m under NMA climbing permits with expert guides.

name: Nepal Tours & Excursions
description: Leisure, cultural heritage, helicopter flights, and wildlife jungle safaris in Chitwan and Pokhara.
